description: The lead agent that plans subtasks at runtime, delegates them to workers and synthesizes the results.
An agent with a clean context that handles one subtask and returns a condensed result.
A plan used when the planner's output is unusable after retries, typically one subtask with the whole question, so the run degrades instead of failing.
The maximum number of calls in flight at once. Keeps a fan-out within provider rate limits.
The final step that combines worker findings into one answer and states which subtasks failed.
Summing the provider-reported usage of every response in a run, including discarded and failed ones.
